subject.title: Doubao: query Coding/Agent Plan usage via arkcli CLI

question: When Doubao source mode is auto and both stored API credentials and an authenticated arkcli session are available, which identity should CodexBar prefer?
rationale: Either precedence can be intentional, but CLI-first changes the established identity source for existing users and may show another account's plan, so repository product intent is required before merge.

options.title: Preserve configured credentials
options.body: Prefer valid stored AK/SK or Ark API credentials in auto mode and use arkcli when credentials are absent or fail, preserving upgrade behavior.

options.title: Adopt CLI-first auto mode
options.body: Keep ambient arkcli ahead of configured credentials, but explicitly document the account-switching upgrade behavior and provide live proof for mixed-account setups.

options.title: Require explicit CLI selection
options.body: Leave auto mode on the existing API path and expose arkcli only through the existing explicit CLI source selection.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured credentials
recommendation.body: Prefer valid stored AK/SK or Ark API credentials in auto mode and use arkcli when credentials are absent or fail, preserving upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is an upgrade and provider-identity policy choice rather than a parser implementation detail.
